files.file: Main page component - displays correlation matrix with ticker selection, lookback period selector, and dynamic data loading from API
TypeScript interfaces: CorrelationMatrixData, CorrelationPanelProps, CorrelationCellProps, LookbackPeriod, TickerPreset
Asset class names, short labels, color schemes, lookback periods, ticker presets, and color utility functions
React Query hook for fetching correlation data; exports utility functions for matrix filtering and correlation value lookup
Triangular heatmap matrix component with color-coded cells, axis labels, tooltips, and legend display
Multi-select dropdown with preset buttons, search filter, Select All/Clear, and visual checkbox indicators
Implementation specification and design reference documentation

page_structure.layout: Single full-width panel with correlation matrix (no tabs)
page_structure.main_component: Displays triangular heatmap of correlation values between selected tickers - Functional: Renders matrix, filters by period and tickers - Features: Color-coded cells (pink=positive, green=negative), tooltips, legend
page_structure.control_component: Multi-select dropdown for choosing which tickers to display - Status: Functional - Features: Preset buttons, search filter, Select All/Clear, count display - Default: Cross-Asset preset on page load
Dropdown to choose time period for correlations - Status: Functional - Options: 1M, 3M (default), 6M, 1Y, 2Y - Controlled by useSelectTracking hook
page_structure.state_component: Displays spinner while data fetches - Status: Functional - Triggered when useCorrelationData returns isLoading=true
Displays error message with alert icon - Status: Functional - Triggered when useCorrelationData returns error
Yellow warning banner shown when fewer than 2 tickers selected - Status: Functional - Message: "Select at least 2 tickers to view correlation matrix"

page_inventory.summary: The Correlation page displays a dynamic, interactive triangular heatmap of correlation values between selected financial assets. It supports preset ticker grouping, multi-select with search, and period selection across 5 lookback windows. Data is fetched from S3 via Lambda proxy API with 30-minute React Query caching. The page is fully functional with proper error handling, loading states, and responsive layout. No major blockers or TODOs found in the code.
